run.decision: PASS ON FROZEN ABSOLUTE VALIDATION GATES / ATM-SVP-3 EVIDENCE WEAK. The fixed Faber-style 10-month GTAA strategy produced 6.589351% CAGR, 0.711267 Sharpe and 22.822440% MDD after the product-level 1.00% fee plus 0.05% slippage, with all 7/7 fixed folds positive-Sharpe. 2020+ CAGR was 4.905284% and 2022+ 4.123781%. The annual equal-weight control had higher CAGR/Sharpe (10.083001% / 0.772414) but much larger MDD (53.617717% versus 22.822440%), so comparison=FAIL because not every comparison gate passed. The high-return objective also fails. Global DSR probability is 0.00011843075 over 67 performance-bearing candidates, so final validation evidence is WEAK, not strong PASS. No trend-window or allocation rescue is permitted inside this lineage.

pass_fail_gates: at least 70% of seven fixed folds have Sharpe >0

methodology.selection_metric: No parameter selection. Exactly one literature-motivated 10-month monthly absolute-trend rule, five fixed 20% sleeves. Validation, objective and annual-equal comparison are independent ATM-SVP-3 axes.

run.title: faber-gtaa-001 / Faber十个月GTAA001; independent absolute-trend sleeves with cash fallback

strategies.description: A simple asset-by-asset long-term trend filter can reduce exposure during persistent bear markets without forecasting the relative winner. At each month boundary, independently investing each fixed 20% sleeve only when the asset latest completed month-end CNY price is above its own 10-month moving average should preserve diversified risk-premium participation while moving broken-trend sleeves to cash, with low enough turnover to remain viable under the product-level fee.

version.mechanism_text: A simple asset-by-asset long-term trend filter can reduce exposure during persistent bear markets without forecasting the relative winner. At each month boundary, independently investing each fixed 20% sleeve only when the asset latest completed month-end CNY price is above its own 10-month moving average should preserve diversified risk-premium participation while moving broken-trend sleeves to cash, with low enough turnover to remain viable under the product-level fee.

allowed_changes: at the first execution session of each new month, independently test each of gold_cny, Nasdaq, S&P 500, CSI300 and Shanghai Composite
for each asset, use the latest completed month-end price and the simple average of exactly the latest ten completed month-end prices
invest exactly 20% portfolio weight in a sleeve only when latest month-end price is strictly greater than its own 10-month average; otherwise that 20% remains CNY cash
review monthly using only T-1 completed observations
one annually rebalanced 20% each five-asset control and one CNY cash control
use product-level 1.00% fee plus 0.05% slippage with no sensitivity grid
forbidden_changes: daily instead of month-end signal sampling
relative ranking, winner selection, Top-N, momentum weighting or inverse-volatility sizing
changing fixed 20% sleeve weights or dropping any asset after results
adding VIX, NFCI, Sahm, yield curve, credit, volatility, drawdown or momentum confirmation
adding hysteresis, buffer bands, minimum persistence days or delayed exits
shorting, borrowing, financing, leverage, gross exposure above 100% or negative cash

shared_rules.review: first execution session of each new calendar month
shared_rules.trend_operator: latest completed month-end price > average of latest ten completed month-end prices
